description: Self-hosted Cloud File Storage Platform Phylum is a self-hosted cloud file storage platform with offline-first web and native clients, meant as a replacement for Google Drive, Dropbox, etc. It is licensed under GNU Affero GPL 3.0 (or later), and is intended to be forever free and non-commercial. Features: 📱 Native clients which are designed to work well with unreliable/no internet connection 👥 Users and Permissions ↺↻ File version history 💿 Remote storage backends 🫆 Auth backends (LDAP, OIDC) 🕸️ WebDAV access 🌍 Publicly share files/folders Phylum may be for you if you want: ✅ To own your data ✅ A fast file manager with native apps - nothing more, nothing less ✅ To support free software without mixed-licensing or paywalls ✅ AI-free software ✅ Something like Immich, but for files Please note that this app requires a server to connect to. Instructions for setting that up can be found on the Project Page
